sections.heading: Land & views.
sections.intro: Rolling fields, old stone walls, and a tree line that catches every sunset. Sixty-seven acres of room to breathe.

sections.heading: The barns.
sections.intro: Two restored barns — one for dinner, one for dancing. Hand-built beams, string lights, and open decks that look out over the valley.
